picks.name: DJ.MC
picks.source_note: Already in your library. New label discovery: Hyperdub.
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Walk Ya Down" (September 25, 2026, Hyperdub) is a two-track release pairing light and dark contrasts -- the title track dark and grimy over a ravey, growling synth line, while "Ghetto Story 2" is catchier, with airy pads over rolling toms.
picks.why_listen: A versatile two-tracker with both a moody peak-time weapon and a brighter, catchier flip -- covers two different moments in a set.

picks.name: Bitchin Bajas
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on Drag City. Similar ambient/textural territory to your Patricia Wolf pick.
picks.bio: "Isle Peaks" (August 28, 2026, Drag City) is a hypnotic, minimalist EP from the Chicago trio (Cooper Crain, Dan Quinlivan, Rob Frye), blending psychedelia with drifting synth and reed textures.
picks.why_listen: Spacious, meditative ambient material -- good for intros, warmups or a comedown stretch late in a set.
